criteria.requirement: Initially request sufficient actual configuration, configspec, validator setup and validation call/result without inventing a failing field or cause. Diagnose only the disclosed validation and application-control evidence, preserve actual error paths/types and limits, and distinguish library behavior from application policy. Unavailable material permits insufficient_information and a concrete evidence plan.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
